formal_question:
How many of the following black-and-white flags have exactly three fifths of their area coloured black?

A:None
B:One
C:Two
D:Three
E:Four

proof.reason: Black stripe multiplicity and black square multiplicity coincide but their denominators differ; the matching colored counts do not imply equal fractions. Black/white areas, not outline color or number of groups, define the question.
